entries.name: AFRI1600
entries.notes: Aerosol Free Vegetation Index (1600 nm). Formula: (N-0.66*S1)/(N+0.66*S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(01)00190-0

entries.name: AFRI2100
entries.notes: Aerosol Free Vegetation Index (2100 nm). Formula: (N-0.5*S2)/(N+0.5*S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(01)00190-0

entries.name: ARI
entries.notes: Anthocyanin Reflectance Index. Formula: (1/G)-(1/RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1562/0031-8655(2001)074%3C0038:OPANEO%3E2.0.CO;2

entries.name: ARI2
entries.notes: Anthocyanin Reflectance Index 2. Formula: N*((1/G)-(1/RE1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1562/0031-8655(2001)074%3C0038:OPANEO%3E2.0.CO;2

entries.name: ARVI
entries.notes: Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-(R-gamma*(R-B)))/(N+(R-gamma*(R-B))). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/36.134076

entries.name: ATSAVI
entries.notes: Adjusted Transformed Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: sla*(N-sla*R-slb)/(sla*N+R-sla*slb+0.08*(1+sla**2.0)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(91)90009-U

entries.name: AVI
entries.notes: Advanced Vegetation Index. Formula: (N*(1.0-R)*(N-R))**(1/3). Reference: http://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/viewdoc/download?doi=10.1.1.465.8749&rep=rep1&type=pdf

entries.name: BCC
entries.notes: Blue Chromatic Coordinate. Formula: B/(R+G+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(87)90088-5

entries.name: BNDVI
entries.notes: Blue Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-B)/(N+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S1672-6308(07)60027-4

entries.longName: Blue Wide Dynamic Range Vegetation Index
entries.name: BWDRVI
entries.notes: Blue Wide Dynamic Range Vegetation Index. Formula: (alpha*N-B)/(alpha*N+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.2135/cropsci2007.01.0031

entries.name: CIG
entries.notes: Chlorophyll Index Green. Formula: (N/G)-1.0. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1078/0176-1617-00887

entries.name: CIRE
entries.notes: Chlorophyll Index Red Edge. Formula: (N/RE1)-1. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1078/0176-1617-00887

entries.name: CRI550
entries.notes: Carotenoid Reflectance Index using 550 nm. Formula: (1.0/B)-(1.0/G). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1562/0031-8655(2002)0750272ACCIPL2.0.CO2

entries.name: CRI700
entries.notes: Carotenoid Reflectance Index using 700 nm. Formula: (1.0/B)-(1.0/RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1562/0031-8655(2002)0750272ACCIPL2.0.CO2

entries.name: CRSWIR
entries.notes: Continuum Removal SWIR. Formula: S1/(N2+((S2-N2)/(lambdaS2-lambdaN2))*(lambdaS1-lambdaN2)). Reference: https://www.onf.fr/onf/+/cec::les-rendez-vous-techniques-de-lonf-no69-70.html

entries.name: CVI
entries.notes: Chlorophyll Vegetation Index. Formula: (N*R)/(G**2.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1007/s11119-010-9204-3

entries.name: DSI
entries.notes: Drought Stress Index. Formula: S1/N. Reference: https://www.asprs.org/wp-content/uploads/pers/1999journal/apr/1999_apr_495-501.pdf

entries.name: DSWI1
entries.notes: Disease-Water Stress Index 1. Formula: N/S1. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160310001618031

entries.name: DSWI2
entries.notes: Disease-Water Stress Index 2. Formula: S1/G. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160310001618031

entries.name: DSWI3
entries.notes: Disease-Water Stress Index 3. Formula: S1/R. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160310001618031

entries.name: DSWI4
entries.notes: Disease-Water Stress Index 4. Formula: G/R. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160310001618031

entries.name: DSWI5
entries.notes: Disease-Water Stress Index 5. Formula: (N+G)/(S1+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160310001618031

entries.name: DVI
entries.notes: Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: N-R. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(94)00114-3

entries.name: DVIplus
entries.notes: Difference Vegetation Index Plus. Formula: ((lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaN-lambdaG))*G+(1.0-((lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaN-lambdaG)))*N-R. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2019.03.028

entries.name: EBI
entries.notes: Enhanced Bloom Index. Formula: (R+G+B)/((G/B)*(R-B+epsilon)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2019.08.006

entries.name: ENDVI
entries.notes: Enhanced Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: ((N+G)-(2*B))/((N+G)+(2*B)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0186193

caveats: Bright blue (cloud, snow, haze) destabilises the denominator, so values can blow out far past ±1. Mask clouds.
Clouds read as moderate vegetation here, not near zero as in NDVI.

classes.label: bare ground · built · dry grass · burns

guide.high: Dense green canopy, without NDVI's early saturation.
guide.low: Water and snow are negative; bare and built ground sit near zero.
guide.measures: Green leaf cover like NDVI, corrected for soil background and haze with the blue band.
guide.source: Huete et al. (2002) coefficients (G 2.5, C1 6, C2 7.5, L 1); bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: EVI
entries.notes: Enhanced Vegetation Index. Formula: g*(N-R)/(N+C1*R-C2*B+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(96)00112-5

entries.name: EVI2
entries.notes: Two-Band Enhanced Vegetation Index. Formula: g*(N-R)/(N+2.4*R+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2008.06.006

entries.name: EVIv
entries.notes: Enhanced Vegetation Index of Vegetation. Formula: 2.5*((N-R)/(N+6*R-7.5*B+1.0))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JG008240

entries.name: ExG
entries.notes: Excess Green Index. Formula: 2*G-R-B. Reference: https://doi.org/10.13031/2013.27838

entries.name: ExGR
entries.notes: ExG - ExR Vegetation Index. Formula: (2.0*G-R-B)-(1.3*R-G). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compag.2008.03.009

entries.name: ExR
entries.notes: Excess Red Index. Formula: 1.3*R-G. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1117/12.336896

entries.name: FCVI
entries.notes: Fluorescence Correction Vegetation Index. Formula: N-((R+G+B)/3.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2020.111676

entries.name: GARI
entries.notes: Green Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-(G-(B-R)))/(N-(G+(B-R))). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(96)00072-7

entries.name: GBNDVI
entries.notes: Green-Blue Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-(G+B))/(N+(G+B)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S1672-6308(07)60027-4

entries.name: GCC
entries.notes: Green Chromatic Coordinate. Formula: G/(R+G+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(87)90088-5

entries.name: GDVI
entries.notes: Generalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: ((N**nexp)-(R**nexp))/((N**nexp)+(R**nexp)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs6021211

entries.name: GLI
entries.notes: Green Leaf Index. Formula: (2.0*G-R-B)/(2.0*G+R+B). Reference: http://dx.doi.org/10.1080/10106040108542184

entries.name: GM1
entries.notes: Gitelson and Merzlyak Index 1. Formula: RE2/G. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0176-1617(96)80284-7

entries.name: GM2
entries.notes: Gitelson and Merzlyak Index 2. Formula: RE2/RE1. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0176-1617(96)80284-7

entries.name: GNDVI
entries.notes: Green Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-G)/(N+G). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(96)00072-7

entries.longName: Green Optimized Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index
entries.name: GOSAVI
entries.notes: Green Optimized Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-G)/(N+G+0.16). Reference: https://doi.org/10.2134/agronj2004.0314

entries.name: GRNDVI
entries.notes: Green-Red Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-(G+R))/(N+(G+R)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S1672-6308(07)60027-4

entries.name: GRVI
entries.notes: Green Ratio Vegetation Index. Formula: N/G. Reference: https://doi.org/10.2134/agronj2004.0314

entries.name: GSAVI
entries.notes: Green Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: (1.0+L)*(N-G)/(N+G+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.2134/agronj2004.0314

entries.name: GVMI
entries.notes: Global Vegetation Moisture Index. Formula: ((N+0.1)-(S2+0.02))/((N+0.1)+(S2+0.02)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(02)00037-8

entries.name: IAVI
entries.notes: New Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-(R-gamma*(B-R)))/(N+(R-gamma*(B-R))). Reference: https://www.jipb.net/EN/abstract/abstract23925.shtml

entries.name: IKAW
entries.notes: Kawashima Index. Formula: (R-B)/(R+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1006/anbo.1997.0544

entries.name: IPVI
entries.notes: Infrared Percentage Vegetation Index. Formula: N/(N+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(90)90085-Z

entries.name: IRECI
entries.notes: Inverted Red-Edge Chlorophyll Index. Formula: (RE3-R)/(RE1/RE2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2013.04.007

entries.name: IRGBVI
entries.notes: Improved-Red-Green-Blue Vegetation Index. Formula: (5.0*(G**2.0)-2.0*(R**2.0)-5.0*(B**2.0))/(5.0*(G**2.0)+2.0*(R**2.0)+5.0*(B**2.0)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2024.103668

entries.longName: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index
entries.name: MCARI
entries.notes: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index. Formula: ((RE1-R)-0.2*(RE1-G))*(RE1/R). Reference: http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(00)00113-9

entries.longName: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 1
entries.name: MCARI1
entries.notes: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 1. Formula: 1.2*(2.5*(N-R)-1.3*(N-G)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2003.12.013

entries.longName: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 2
entries.name: MCARI2
entries.notes: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 2. Formula: (1.5*(2.5*(N-R)-1.3*(N-G)))/((((2.0*N+1)**2)-(6.0*N-5*(R**0.5))-0.5)**0.5). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2003.12.013

entries.longName: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index (705 and 750 nm)
entries.name: MCARI705
entries.notes: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index (705 and 750 nm). Formula: ((RE2-RE1)-0.2*(RE2-G))*(RE2/RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.agrformet.2008.03.005

entries.name: MCARIOSAVI
entries.notes: MCARI/OSAVI Ratio. Formula: (((RE1-R)-0.2*(RE1-G))*(RE1/R))/(1.16*(N-R)/(N+R+0.16)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(00)00113-9

entries.name: MCARIOSAVI705
entries.notes: MCARI/OSAVI Ratio (705 and 750 nm). Formula: (((RE2-RE1)-0.2*(RE2-G))*(RE2/RE1))/(1.16*(RE2-RE1)/(RE2+RE1+0.16)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.agrformet.2008.03.005

entries.name: MGRVI
entries.notes: Modified Green Red Vegetation Index. Formula: (G**2.0-R**2.0)/(G**2.0+R**2.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2015.02.012

entries.name: MI
entries.notes: Mangrove Index. Formula: (N-S1)/(N*S1). Reference: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Gathot-Winarso/publication/277137915_NEW_MANGROVE_INDEX_AS_DEGRADATIONHEALTH_INDICATOR_USING_REMOTE_SENSING_DATA_SEGARA_ANAKAN_AND_ALAS_PURWO_CASE_STUDY/links/5562d90c08ae8c0cab333ab4/NEW-MANGROVE-INDEX-AS-DEGRADATION-HEALTH-INDICATOR-USING-REMOTE-SENSING-DATA-SEGARA-ANAKAN-AND-ALAS-PURWO-CASE-STUDY.pdf

entries.name: MNDVI
entries.notes: Modified Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-S2)/(N+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/014311697216810

entries.name: MNLI
entries.notes: Modified Non-Linear Vegetation Index. Formula: (1+L)*((N**2)-R)/((N**2)+R+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2003.812910

entries.name: MRBVI
entries.notes: Modified Red Blue Vegetation Index. Formula: (R**2.0-B**2.0)/(R**2.0+B**2.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/s20185055

caveats: Most useful where vegetation is patchy over bright soil (drylands, early-season crops).

classes.label: bare ground · built · dry grass · burns

guide.low: Water and snow are negative; bare and built ground sit near zero.
guide.measures: Green leaf cover with a soil correction that adapts to canopy density.
guide.source: Qi et al. (1994); bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: MSAVI
entries.notes: Modified Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: 0.5*(2.0*N+1-(((2*N+1)**2)-8*(N-R))**0.5). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(94)90134-1

entries.name: MSI
entries.notes: Moisture Stress Index. Formula: S1/N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(89)90046-1

entries.name: MSR
entries.notes: Modified Simple Ratio. Formula: (N/R-1)/((N/R+1)**0.5). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/07038992.1996.10855178

entries.name: MSR705
entries.notes: Modified Simple Ratio (705 and 750 nm). Formula: (RE2/RE1-1)/((RE2/RE1+1)**0.5). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.agrformet.2008.03.005

entries.name: MTCI
entries.notes: MERIS Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index. Formula: (RE2-RE1)/(RE1-R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/0143116042000274015

entries.name: MTVI1
entries.notes: Modified Triangular Vegetation Index 1. Formula: 1.2*(1.2*(N-G)-2.5*(R-G)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2003.12.013

entries.name: MTVI2
entries.notes: Modified Triangular Vegetation Index 2. Formula: (1.5*(1.2*(N-G)-2.5*(R-G)))/((((2.0*N+1)**2)-(6.0*N-5*(R**0.5))-0.5)**0.5). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2003.12.013

entries.name: MVI
entries.notes: Mangrove Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-G)/(S1-G). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2020.06.001

entries.name: ND705
entries.notes: Normalized Difference (705 and 750 nm). Formula: (RE2-RE1)/(RE2+RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(02)00010-X

entries.name: NDDI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Drought Index. Formula: (((N-R)/(N+R))-((G-N)/(G+N)))/(((N-R)/(N+R))+((G-N)/(G+N))). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2006GL029127

entries.name: NDGI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Greenness Index. Formula: (((lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaN-lambdaG))*G+(1.0-((lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaN-lambdaG)))*N-R)/(((lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaN-lambdaG))*G+(1.0-((lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaN-lambdaG)))*N+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2019.03.028

entries.name: NDII
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Infrared Index. Formula: (N-S1)/(N+S1). Reference: https://www.asprs.org/wp-content/uploads/pers/1983journal/jan/1983_jan_77-83.pdf

caveats: Water and snow read high for optical reasons, not because they are "moist vegetation"; mask or crop them out when reading canopy stress.
Also published as Gao's NDWI; not the same index as McFeeters' NDWI.
guide.high: Well-watered dense canopy; water and snow read high too.
guide.low: Dry ground, dry grass and fresh burns.
guide.measures: Near-infrared against shortwave-infrared reflectance, a proxy for water held in leaves.
guide.source: Gao (1996) and Wilson & Sader (2002); bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: NDMI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Moisture Index. Formula: (N-S1)/(N+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(01)00318-2

entries.name: NDPI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Phenology Index. Formula: (N-(alpha*R+(1.0-alpha)*S1))/(N+(alpha*R+(1.0-alpha)*S1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2017.04.031

entries.name: NDREI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Red Edge Index. Formula: (N-RE1)/(N+RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/1011-1344(93)06963-4

entries.longName: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Tillage Index
entries.name: NDTI4RE
entries.notes: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Tillage Index. Formula: gamma*(S1-S2)/(S1+S2)+(1-gamma)*(N-RE3)/(N+RE3). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102793

entries.name: NDTillI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Tillage Index. Formula: (S1-S2)/(S1+S2). Reference: https://www.asprs.org/wp-content/uploads/pers/1997journal/jan/1997_jan_87-93.pdf

caveats: Saturates over dense canopy; forests and lush crops crowd together above 0.8. EVI keeps contrast there.
Bright soil lifts sparse canopies; SAVI or MSAVI correct for it.
Thin cloud and haze pull values toward zero; keep the mask on.

guide.measures: How much more near-infrared than red light the surface reflects, a proxy for green leaf cover.
guide.source: USGS EROS NDVI phenology guidance (bare < 0.1, shrub and grass 0.2–0.3, forest 0.6–0.8); bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: NDVI

entries.longName: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
entries.name: NDVI4RE
entries.notes: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: ((alpha*RE3+(1-alpha)*RE2)-(beta*R+(1-beta)*RE1))/((alpha*RE3+(1-alpha)*RE2)+(beta*R+(1-beta)*RE1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102793

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (705 and 750 nm)
entries.name: NDVI705
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (705 and 750 nm). Formula: (RE2-RE1)/(RE2+RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0176-1617(11)81633-0

entries.name: NDYI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Yellowness Index. Formula: (G-B)/(G+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2016.06.016

entries.name: NGRDI
entries.notes: Normalized Green Red Difference Index. Formula: (G-R)/(G+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(79)90013-0

entries.name: NIRv
entries.notes: Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation. Formula: ((N-R)/(N+R))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.1602244

entries.name: NIRvH2
entries.notes: Hyperspectral Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation. Formula: N-R-k*(lambdaN-lambdaR). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2021.112723

entries.name: NIRvP
entries.notes: Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation and Incoming PAR. Formula: ((N-R)/(N+R))*N*PAR. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2021.112763

entries.name: NLI
entries.notes: Non-Linear Vegetation Index. Formula: ((N**2)-R)/((N**2)+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/02757259409532252

entries.name: NMDI
entries.notes: Normalized Multi-band Drought Index. Formula: (N-(S1-S2))/(N+(S1-S2)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2007GL031021

entries.name: NPCI
entries.notes: Normalized Pigments Chlorophyll Ratio Index. Formula: (R-A)/(R+A). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(94)90136-8

entries.name: NRFIg
entries.notes: Normalized Rapeseed Flowering Index Green. Formula: (G-S2)/(G+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs13010105

entries.name: NRFIr
entries.notes: Normalized Rapeseed Flowering Index Red. Formula: (R-S2)/(R+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs13010105

entries.name: NormNIR

entries.name: NormR
entries.notes: Normalized Red. Formula: R/(N+G+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.2134/agronj2004.0314

entries.name: OCVI

entries.name: OSAVI
entries.notes: Optimized Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-R)/(N+R+0.16). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(95)00186-7

entries.name: PSRI
entries.notes: Plant Senescing Reflectance Index. Formula: (R-B)/RE2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1034/j.1399-3054.1999.106119.x

entries.name: RCC
entries.notes: Red Chromatic Coordinate. Formula: R/(R+G+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(87)90088-5

entries.name: RDVI
entries.notes: Renormalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (N-R)/((N+R)**0.5). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(94)00114-3

entries.name: REDSI
entries.notes: Red-Edge Disease Stress Index. Formula: ((705.0-665.0)*(RE3-R)-(783.0-665.0)*(RE1-R))/(2.0*R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/s18030868

entries.longName: Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
entries.name: RENDVI
entries.notes: Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (RE2-RE1)/(RE2+RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0176-1617(11)81633-0

entries.name: RGBVI
entries.notes: Red Green Blue Vegetation Index. Formula: (G**2.0-B*R)/(G**2.0+B*R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2015.02.012

entries.name: RGRI
entries.notes: Red-Green Ratio Index. Formula: R/G. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2014.03.018

entries.name: RI
entries.notes: Redness Index. Formula: (R-G)/(R+G). Reference: https://www.documentation.ird.fr/hor/fdi:34390

entries.name: RVI
entries.notes: Ratio Vegetation Index. Formula: RE2/R. Reference: https://doi.org/10.2134/agronj1968.00021962006000060016x

entries.notes: 4-band Red Edge Ratio Vegetation Index. Formula: (alpha*RE3+(1-alpha)*RE2)/(beta*R+(1-beta)*RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102793

entries.name: S2REP
entries.notes: Sentinel-2 Red-Edge Position. Formula: 705.0+35.0*((((RE3+R)/2.0)-RE1)/(RE2-RE1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2013.04.007

entries.name: SARVI
entries.notes: Soil Adjusted and Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index. Formula: (1+L)*(N-(R-(R-B)))/(N+(R-(R-B))+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/36.134076

caveats: Reads lower than NDVI for the same canopy; don't compare the two on one fixed range.

guide.low: Water and snow are negative; bare and built ground sit near zero.
guide.measures: Green leaf cover with a soil-brightness correction (L = 0.5), for sparse canopies over bright ground.
guide.source: Huete (1988); bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: SAVI
entries.notes: Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: (1.0+L)*(N-R)/(N+R+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(88)90106-X

entries.name: SAVI2
entries.notes: Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index 2. Formula: N/(R+(slb/sla)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431169008955053

entries.longName: 4-band Red Edge Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index
entries.name: SAVI4RE
entries.notes: 4-band Red Edge Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: 2.0*((alpha*RE3+(1-alpha)*RE2)-(beta*R+(1-beta)*RE1))/((alpha*RE3+(1-alpha)*RE2)+(beta*R+(1-beta)*RE1+1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102793

entries.name: SEVI
entries.notes: Shadow-Eliminated Vegetation Index. Formula: (N/R)+fdelta*(1.0/R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/17538947.2018.1495770

entries.name: SI
entries.notes: Shadow Index. Formula: ((1.0-B)*(1.0-G)*(1.0-R))**(1/3). Reference: http://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/viewdoc/download?doi=10.1.1.465.8749&rep=rep1&type=pdf

entries.name: SIPI
entries.notes: Structure Insensitive Pigment Index. Formula: (N-A)/(N-R). Reference: https://eurekamag.com/research/009/395/009395053.php

entries.name: SLAVI
entries.notes: Specific Leaf Area Vegetation Index. Formula: N/(R+S2). Reference: https://www.asprs.org/wp-content/uploads/pers/2000journal/february/2000_feb_183-191.pdf

entries.name: SNDTI
entries.notes: Soil-Adjusted Normalized Difference Tillage Index. Formula: (1.0+L)*(S1-S2)/(S1+S2+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/22797254.2017.1418186

entries.longName: 4-band Red Edge Soil-Adjusted Normalized Difference Tillage Index
entries.name: SNDTI4RE
entries.notes: 4-band Red Edge Soil-Adjusted Normalized Difference Tillage Index. Formula: gamma*((S1-S2)*2.0)/(S1+S2+1.0)+(1-gamma)*((N-RE3)*2.0)/(N+RE3+1.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102793

entries.name: SR
entries.notes: Simple Ratio. Formula: N/R. Reference: https://doi.org/10.2307/1936256

entries.name: SR2
entries.notes: Simple Ratio (800 and 550 nm). Formula: N/G. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431169308904370

entries.name: SR3
entries.notes: Simple Ratio (860, 550 and 708 nm). Formula: N2/(G*RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(98)00046-7

entries.name: SR555
entries.notes: Simple Ratio (555 and 750 nm). Formula: RE2/G. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0176-1617(11)81633-0

entries.name: SR705
entries.notes: Simple Ratio (705 and 750 nm). Formula: RE2/RE1. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0176-1617(11)81633-0

entries.name: STI
entries.notes: Simple Tillage Index. Formula: S1/S2. Reference: https://www.asprs.org/wp-content/uploads/pers/1997journal/jan/1997_jan_87-93.pdf

entries.name: STI4RE
entries.notes: 4-band Red Edge Soil Tillage Index. Formula: gamma*S1/S2+(1-gamma)*N/RE3. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102793

entries.name: SeLI
entries.notes: Sentinel-2 LAI Green Index. Formula: (N2-RE1)/(N2+RE1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/s19040904

entries.longName: Transformed Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index
entries.name: TCARI
entries.notes: Transformed Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index. Formula: 3*((RE1-R)-0.2*(RE1-G)*(RE1/R)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(02)00018-4

entries.name: TCARIOSAVI
entries.notes: TCARI/OSAVI Ratio. Formula: (3*((RE1-R)-0.2*(RE1-G)*(RE1/R)))/(1.16*(N-R)/(N+R+0.16)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(02)00018-4

entries.name: TCARIOSAVI705
entries.notes: TCARI/OSAVI Ratio (705 and 750 nm). Formula: (3*((RE2-RE1)-0.2*(RE2-G)*(RE2/RE1)))/(1.16*(RE2-RE1)/(RE2+RE1+0.16)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.agrformet.2008.03.005

entries.name: TCI
entries.notes: Triangular Chlorophyll Index. Formula: 1.2*(RE1-G)-1.5*(R-G)*(RE1/R)**0.5. Reference: http://dx.doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2007.904836

entries.name: TDVI
entries.notes: Transformed Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: 1.5*((N-R)/((N**2.0+R+0.5)**0.5)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS.2002.1026867

entries.name: TGI
entries.notes: Triangular Greenness Index. Formula: -0.5*(190*(R-G)-120*(R-B)). Reference: http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2012.07.020

entries.name: TRRVI
entries.notes: Transformed Red Range Vegetation Index. Formula: ((RE2-R)/(RE2+R))/(((N-R)/(N+R))+1.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs12152359

entries.name: TSAVI
entries.notes: Transformed Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index. Formula: sla*(N-sla*R-slb)/(sla*N+R-sla*slb). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS.1989.576128

entries.name: TTVI
entries.notes: Transformed Triangular Vegetation Index. Formula: 0.5*((865.0-740.0)*(RE3-RE2)-(N2-RE2)*(783.0-740)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs12010016

entries.name: TVI
entries.notes: Transformed Vegetation Index. Formula: (((N-R)/(N+R))+0.5)**0.5. Reference: https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19740022614

entries.name: TriVI
entries.notes: Triangular Vegetation Index. Formula: 0.5*(120*(N-G)-200*(R-G)). Reference: http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(00)00197-8

entries.name: VARI
entries.notes: Visible Atmospherically Resistant Index. Formula: (G-R)/(G+R-B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(01)00289-9

entries.name: VARI700
entries.notes: Visible Atmospherically Resistant Index (700 nm). Formula: (RE1-1.7*R+0.7*B)/(RE1+1.3*R-1.3*B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(01)00289-9

entries.name: VI700
entries.notes: Vegetation Index (700 nm). Formula: (RE1-R)/(RE1+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(01)00289-9

entries.name: VIG
entries.notes: Vegetation Index Green. Formula: (G-R)/(G+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(01)00289-9

entries.name: WDRVI
entries.notes: Wide Dynamic Range Vegetation Index. Formula: (alpha*N-R)/(alpha*N+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1078/0176-1617-01176

entries.name: WDVI
entries.notes: Weighted Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: N-sla*R. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/0034-4257(89)90076-X

entries.name: bNIRv
entries.notes: Blue Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation. Formula: ((N-B)/(N+B))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JG008240

entries.name: mND705
entries.notes: Modified Normalized Difference (705, 750 and 445 nm). Formula: (RE2-RE1)/(RE2+RE1-A). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(02)00010-X

entries.name: mSR705
entries.notes: Modified Simple Ratio (705 and 445 nm). Formula: (RE2-A)/(RE2+A). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(02)00010-X

entries.longName: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for LSWI
entries.name: sNIRvLSWI
entries.notes: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for LSWI. Formula: ((N-S2)/(N+S2))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JG008240

entries.longName: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for NDPI
entries.name: sNIRvNDPI
entries.notes: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for NDPI. Formula: (N-(alpha*R+(1.0-alpha)*S2))/(N+(alpha*R+(1.0-alpha)*S2))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JG008240

entries.longName: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Product
entries.name: sNIRvNDVILSWIP
entries.notes: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Product. Formula: ((N-R)/(N+R))*((N-S2)/(N+S2))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JG008240

entries.longName: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Sum
entries.name: sNIRvNDVILSWIS
entries.notes: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Sum. Formula: (((N-R)/(N+R))+((N-S2)/(N+S2)))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JG008240

entries.name: sNIRvSWIR
entries.notes: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation. Formula: ((N-R-S2**2.0)/(N+R+S2**2.0))*N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JG008240

entries.name: ANDWI
entries.notes: Augmented Normalized Difference Water Index. Formula: (B+G+R-N-S1-S2)/(B+G+R+N+S1+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envsoft.2021.105030

entries.name: AWEInsh
entries.notes: Automated Water Extraction Index. Formula: 4.0*(G-S1)-0.25*N+2.75*S2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2013.08.029

entries.longName: Automated Water Extraction Index with Shadows Elimination
entries.name: AWEIsh
entries.notes: Automated Water Extraction Index with Shadows Elimination. Formula: B+2.5*G-1.5*(N+S1)-0.25*S2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2013.08.029

entries.name: FAI
entries.notes: Floating Algae Index. Formula: N-(R+(S1-R)*((lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaS1-lambdaR))). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2009.05.012

entries.name: FDI
entries.notes: Floating Debris Index. Formula: N-(RE2+10*(S1-RE2)*(lambdaN-lambdaR)/(lambdaS1-lambdaR)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-020-62298-z

entries.name: FWEI
entries.notes: Flood/Water Extraction Index. Formula: (((B+G+R)/3.0)-N)/(((B+G+R)/3.0)+N). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1007/s00477-024-02660-z

entries.name: LSWI
entries.notes: Land Surface Water Index. Formula: (N-S1)/(N+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2003.11.008

entries.name: MBWI
entries.notes: Multi-Band Water Index. Formula: (omega*G)-R-N-S1-S2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2018.01.018

entries.longName: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 6)
entries.name: MLSWI26
entries.notes: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 6). Formula: (1.0-N-S1)/(1.0-N+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs71215805

entries.longName: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 7)
entries.name: MLSWI27
entries.notes: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 7). Formula: (1.0-N-S2)/(1.0-N+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs71215805

caveats: Snow and ice read like water; check the season and elevation.
Clear, deep water reflects almost no shortwave infrared, so its value is noisy scene to scene even though it is always high.
guide.high: Open water, and snow (which MNDWI can't tell apart from water).
guide.measures: Green against shortwave-infrared reflectance; open water stands out and built-up land is suppressed.
guide.source: Xu (2006), water above 0; bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: MNDWI
entries.notes: Modified Normalized Difference Water Index. Formula: (G-S1)/(G+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160600589179

entries.name: MuWIR
entries.notes: Revised Multi-Spectral Water Index. Formula: -4.0*((B-G)/(B+G))+2.0*((G-N)/(G+N))+2.0*((G-S2)/(G+S2))-((G-S1)/(G+S1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs10101643

entries.name: NDCI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index. Formula: (RE1-R)/(RE1+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2011.10.016

entries.name: NDPonI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Pond Index. Formula: (S1-G)/(S1+G). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2006.07.012

entries.name: NDTI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Turbidity Index. Formula: (R-G)/(R+G). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2006.07.012

entries.name: NDVIMNDWI
entries.notes: NDVI-MNDWI Model. Formula: ((N-R)/(N+R))-((G-S1)/(G+S1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-662-45737-5_51

caveats: Built-up surfaces can creep above zero and read as water; MNDWI suppresses them.
This is McFeeters' water index; the canopy-moisture NDWI of Gao is NDMI here.

guide.measures: Green against near-infrared reflectance, which separates open water from land.
guide.source: McFeeters (1996), water above 0; bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: NDWI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Water Index. Formula: (G-N)/(G+N). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431169608948714

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Water Index with no Snow Cover and Glaciers
entries.name: NDWIns
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Water Index with no Snow Cover and Glaciers. Formula: (G-alpha*N)/(G+N). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/w12051339

entries.name: NWI
entries.notes: New Water Index. Formula: (B-(N+S1+S2))/(B+(N+S1+S2)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.11873/j.issn.1004-0323.2009.2.167

entries.name: OSI
entries.notes: Oil Spill Index. Formula: (G+R)/B. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mex.2021.101327

entries.name: PI
entries.notes: Plastic Index. Formula: N/(N+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs12162648

entries.name: RNDVI
entries.notes: Reversed Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Formula: (R-N)/(R+N). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs12162648

entries.name: S2WI
entries.notes: Sentinel-2 Water Index. Formula: (RE1-S2)/(RE1+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/w13121647

entries.name: SCoWI
entries.notes: Subtractive Coastal Water Index. Formula: B+2.0*(G-N)-0.75*S1-0.5*S2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs16152795

entries.name: SWM
entries.notes: Sentinel Water Mask. Formula: (B+G)/(N+S1). Reference: https://eoscience.esa.int/landtraining2017/files/posters/MILCZAREK.pdf

entries.name: TWI
entries.notes: Triangle Water Index. Formula: (2.84*(RE1-RE2)/(G+S2))+((1.25*(G-B)-(N-B))/(N+1.25*G-0.25*B)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs14215289

entries.name: WI1
entries.notes: Water Index 1. Formula: (G-S2)/(G+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs11182186

entries.name: WI2
entries.notes: Water Index 2. Formula: (B-S2)/(B+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs11182186

entries.name: WI2015
entries.notes: Water Index 2015. Formula: 1.7204+171*G+3*R-70*N-45*S1-71*S2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2015.12.055

entries.name: WRI
entries.notes: Water Ratio Index. Formula: (G+R)/(N+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/GEOINFORMATICS.2010.5567762

entries.name: BAI
entries.notes: Burned Area Index. Formula: 1.0/((0.1-R)**2.0+(0.06-N)**2.0). Reference: https://digital.csic.es/bitstream/10261/6426/1/Martin_Isabel_Serie_Geografica.pdf

entries.longName: Burned Area Index adapted to MODIS
entries.name: BAIM
entries.notes: Burned Area Index adapted to MODIS. Formula: 1.0/((0.05-N)**2.0)+((0.2-S2)**2.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.foreco.2006.08.248

entries.name: BAIS2
entries.notes: Burned Area Index for Sentinel 2. Formula: (1.0-((RE2*RE3*N2)/R)**0.5)*(((S2-N2)/(S2+N2)**0.5)+1.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/ecrs-2-05177

entries.name: CSI
entries.notes: Char Soil Index. Formula: N/S2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2005.04.014

entries.name: MIRBI
entries.notes: Mid-Infrared Burn Index. Formula: 10.0*S2-9.8*S1+2.0. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160110053185

caveats: One date can't tell a burn scar from bare soil. Burn severity is the pre- minus post-fire difference (dNBR).
Snow and water read high; mask them when comparing burns.

classes.label: fresh burns · bare soil · dry grass

guide.low: Fresh burn scars, then bare soil and dry grass.
guide.measures: Near-infrared against long shortwave-infrared reflectance; burning drops the first and raises the second.
guide.source: Key & Benson (2006), FIREMON; bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: NBR
entries.notes: Normalized Burn Ratio. Formula: (N-S2)/(N+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3133/ofr0211

entries.name: NBR2
entries.notes: Normalized Burn Ratio 2. Formula: (S1-S2)/(S1+S2). Reference: https://www.usgs.gov/core-science-systems/nli/landsat/landsat-normalized-burn-ratio-2

entries.name: NBRSWIR
entries.notes: Normalized Burn Ratio SWIR. Formula: (S2-S1-0.02)/(S2+S1+0.1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/22797254.2020.1738900

entries.name: NBRplus
entries.notes: Normalized Burn Ratio Plus. Formula: (S2-N2-G-B)/(S2+N2+G+B). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs14071727

entries.name: NDSWIR
entries.notes: Normalized Difference SWIR. Formula: (N-S1)/(N+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2003.819190

caveats: Built-up land sits between vegetation and bare soil; it isn't isolated.

guide.high: Bare soil, sand, dry grass and burns.
guide.measures: Shortwave-infrared and red against near-infrared and blue, which picks out exposed soil.
guide.source: Rikimaru et al. (2002) bare soil index; bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: BI
entries.notes: Bare Soil Index. Formula: ((S1+R)-(N+B))/((S1+R)+(N+B)). Reference: http://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/viewdoc/download?doi=10.1.1.465.8749&rep=rep1&type=pdf

entries.name: BITM
entries.notes: Landsat TM-based Brightness Index. Formula: (((B**2.0)+(G**2.0)+(R**2.0))/3.0)**0.5. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(98)00030-3

entries.name: BIXS
entries.notes: SPOT HRV XS-based Brightness Index. Formula: (((G**2.0)+(R**2.0))/2.0)**0.5. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(98)00030-3

entries.name: BaI
entries.notes: Bareness Index. Formula: R+S1-N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS.2005.1525743

entries.name: DBSI
entries.notes: Dry Bareness Index. Formula: ((S1-G)/(S1+G))-((N-R)/(N+R)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/land7030081

entries.name: EMBI
entries.notes: Enhanced Modified Bare Soil Index. Formula: ((((S1-S2-N)/(S1+S2+N))+0.5)-((G-S1)/(G+S1))-0.5)/((((S1-S2-N)/(S1+S2+N))+0.5)+((G-S1)/(G+S1))+1.5). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102703

entries.name: MBI
entries.notes: Modified Bare Soil Index. Formula: ((S1-S2-N)/(S1+S2+N))+0.5. Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/land10030231

entries.name: NDSoI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Soil Index. Formula: (S2-G)/(S2+G). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2015.02.010

entries.name: NSDS
entries.notes: Normalized Shortwave Infrared Difference Soil-Moisture. Formula: (S1-S2)/(S1+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/land10030231

entries.longName: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 1
entries.name: NSDSI1
entries.notes: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 1. Formula: (S1-S2)/S1. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2019.06.012

entries.longName: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 2
entries.name: NSDSI2
entries.notes: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 2. Formula: (S1-S2)/S2. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2019.06.012

entries.longName: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 3
entries.name: NSDSI3
entries.notes: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 3. Formula: (S1-S2)/(S1+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2019.06.012

entries.name: RI4XS
entries.notes: SPOT HRV XS-based Redness Index 4. Formula: (R**2.0)/(G**4.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0034-4257(98)00030-3

entries.name: BLFEI
entries.notes: Built-Up Land Features Extraction Index. Formula: (((G+R+S2)/3.0)-S1)/(((G+R+S2)/3.0)+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/10106049.2018.1497094

entries.name: BRBA
entries.notes: Band Ratio for Built-up Area. Formula: R/S1. Reference: https://www.omicsonline.org/scientific-reports/JGRS-SR136.pdf

entries.name: NBAI
entries.notes: Normalized Built-up Area Index. Formula: (S2-S1/G)/(S2+S1/G). Reference: https://www.omicsonline.org/scientific-reports/JGRS-SR136.pdf

caveats: NDBI confuses cities with bare and dry ground. Here dense city fabric reads lower than a ploughed field.
The reverse of NDMI on Sentinel-2 (NDBI = −NDMI).
guide.high: Bare soil, dry grass and burns; built-up land is only mildly positive.
guide.measures: Shortwave-infrared against near-infrared reflectance; built surfaces and bare ground reflect more SWIR than vegetation.
guide.source: Zha et al. (2003); bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: NDBI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Built-Up Index. Formula: (S1-N)/(S1+N). Reference: http://dx.doi.org/10.1080/01431160304987

entries.name: NHFD
entries.notes: Non-Homogeneous Feature Difference. Formula: (RE1-A)/(RE1+A). Reference: https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/Using-WorldView-2-Vis-NIR-MSI-Imagery-to-Support-Wolf/5e5063ccc4ee76b56b721c866e871d47a77f9fb4

entries.name: PISI
entries.notes: Perpendicular Impervious Surface Index. Formula: 0.8192*B-0.5735*N+0.0750. Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs10101521

entries.name: UI
entries.notes: Urban Index. Formula: (S2-N)/(S2+N). Reference: https://www.isprs.org/proceedings/XXXI/congress/part7/321_XXXI-part7.pdf

entries.name: VIBI
entries.notes: Vegetation Index Built-up Index. Formula: ((N-R)/(N+R))/(((N-R)/(N+R))+((S1-N)/(S1+N))). Reference: http://dx.doi.org/10.1080/01431161.2012.687842

entries.name: VgNIRBI
entries.notes: Visible Green-Based Built-Up Index. Formula: (G-N)/(G+N). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolind.2015.03.037

entries.name: VrNIRBI
entries.notes: Visible Red-Based Built-Up Index. Formula: (R-N)/(R+N). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolind.2015.03.037

entries.longName: Non-Binary Snow Index for Multi-Component Surfaces
entries.name: NBSIMS
entries.notes: Non-Binary Snow Index for Multi-Component Surfaces. Formula: 0.36*(G+R+N)-(((B+S2)/G)+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs13142777

entries.name: NDGlaI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Glacier Index. Formula: (G-R)/(G+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160802385459

caveats: Water passes the snow threshold too; operational snow maps also require NIR above ~0.11.
Same formula as MNDWI on Sentinel-2; only the reading differs.

classes.label: cloud · patchy or dirty snow · water edges

guide.high: Snow and ice, and also water, which shares the signature.
guide.measures: Green against shortwave-infrared reflectance; snow is bright in green and dark in SWIR.
guide.source: Hall et al. (1995) snow threshold 0.4; bands checked against the reference surfaces.

entries.name: NDSI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Snow Index. Formula: (G-S1)/(G+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS.1994.399618

entries.name: NDSII
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Snow Ice Index. Formula: (G-N)/(G+N). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160802385459

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Snow/Ice Index for Landsat TM
entries.name: NDSIITM
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Snow/Ice Index for Landsat TM. Formula: (R-S1)/(R+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160119766

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Snow Index with no Water
entries.name: NDSInw
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Snow Index with no Water. Formula: (N-S1-beta)/(N+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/w12051339

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Snow and Ice Index
entries.name: NDSaII
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Snow and Ice Index. Formula: (R-S1)/(R+S1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160119766

entries.name: S3
entries.notes: S3 Snow Index. Formula: (N*(R-S1))/((N+R)*(N+S1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3178/jjshwr.12.28

entries.name: SWI
entries.notes: Snow Water Index. Formula: (G*(N-S1))/((G+N)*(N+S1)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs11232774

entries.name: CI1SWIR
entries.notes: Cloud Index Form 1 with SWIR 1. Formula: (N+2.0*S1)/(B+G+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2018.07.006

entries.longName: Cloud Index Form 1 without SWIR bands
entries.name: CI1woSWIR
entries.notes: Cloud Index Form 1 without SWIR bands. Formula: (3.0*N)/(B+G+R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2018.07.006

entries.longName: Cloud Index Form 2 with SWIR bands
entries.name: CI2SWIR
entries.notes: Cloud Index Form 2 with SWIR bands. Formula: (B+G+R+N+S1+S2)/6.0. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2018.07.006

entries.longName: Cloud Index Form 2 without SWIR bands
entries.name: CI2woSWIR
entries.notes: Cloud Index Form 2 without SWIR bands. Formula: (B+G+R+N)/4.0. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2018.07.006

entries.name: CLOSDI
entries.notes: Cloud Shadow Detection Index. Formula: (1.0-1.5*N-0.1*R)/(1.0+3.5*N+4.9*R). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rsase.2026.101990

entries.name: CSISWIR
entries.notes: Cloud Shadow Index with SWIR 1. Formula: (N+S1)/2.0. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2018.07.006

entries.longName: Cloud Shadow Index without SWIR bands
entries.name: CSIwoSWIR
entries.notes: Cloud Shadow Index without SWIR bands. Formula: N. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2018.07.006

entries.name: CSIT
entries.notes: Char Soil Index Thermal. Formula: N/(S2*T/10000.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160600954704

entries.name: NBRT1
entries.notes: Normalized Burn Ratio Thermal 1. Formula: (N-(S2*T/10000.0))/(N+(S2*T/10000.0)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160500239008

entries.name: NBRT2
entries.notes: Normalized Burn Ratio Thermal 2. Formula: ((N/(T/10000.0))-S2)/((N/(T/10000.0))+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160500239008

entries.name: NBRT3
entries.notes: Normalized Burn Ratio Thermal 3. Formula: ((N-(T/10000.0))-S2)/((N-(T/10000.0))+S2). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160500239008

entries.name: NDVIT
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index Thermal. Formula: (N-(R*T/10000.0))/(N+(R*T/10000.0)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160600954704

entries.name: NSTv1
entries.notes: NIR-SWIR-Temperature Version 1. Formula: ((N-S2)/(N+S2))*T. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2011.06.010

entries.name: NSTv2
entries.notes: NIR-SWIR-Temperature Version 2. Formula: (N-(S2+T))/(N+(S2+T)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2011.06.010

entries.name: SAVIT
entries.notes: Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index Thermal. Formula: (1.0+L)*(N-(R*T/10000.0))/(N+(R*T/10000.0)+L). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160600954704

entries.name: VI6T
entries.notes: VI6T Index. Formula: (N-T/10000.0)/(N+T/10000.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1080/01431160500239008

entries.name: NBLI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Bare Land Index. Formula: (R-T)/(R+T). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs9030249

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Bare Land Index for Landsat-OLI
entries.name: NBLIOLI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Bare Land Index for Landsat-OLI. Formula: (R-T1)/(R+T1). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs9030249

entries.name: NDBaI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Bareness Index. Formula: (S1-T)/(S1+T). Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS.2005.1526319

entries.name: DBI
entries.notes: Dry Built-Up Index. Formula: ((B-T1)/(B+T1))-((N-R)/(N+R)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/land7030081

entries.name: EBBI
entries.notes: Enhanced Built-Up and Bareness Index. Formula: (S1-N)/(10.0*((S1+T)**0.5)). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs4102957

entries.name: NBUI
entries.notes: New Built-Up Index. Formula: ((S1-N)/(10.0*(T+S1)**0.5))-(((N-R)*(1.0+L))/(N-R+L))-(G-S1)/(G+S1). Reference: https://hdl.handle.net/1959.11/29500

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Blue
entries.name: NDISIb
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Blue. Formula: (T-(B+N+S1)/3.0)/(T+(B+N+S1)/3.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.14358/PERS.76.5.557

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Green
entries.name: NDISIg
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Green. Formula: (T-(G+N+S1)/3.0)/(T+(G+N+S1)/3.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.14358/PERS.76.5.557

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index with MNDWI
entries.name: NDISImndwi
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index with MNDWI. Formula: (T-(((G-S1)/(G+S1))+N+S1)/3.0)/(T+(((G-S1)/(G+S1))+N+S1)/3.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.14358/PERS.76.5.557

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index with NDWI
entries.name: NDISIndwi
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index with NDWI. Formula: (T-(((G-N)/(G+N))+N+S1)/3.0)/(T+(((G-N)/(G+N))+N+S1)/3.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.14358/PERS.76.5.557

entries.longName: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Red
entries.name: NDISIr
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Impervious Surface Index Red. Formula: (T-(R+N+S1)/3.0)/(T+(R+N+S1)/3.0). Reference: https://doi.org/10.14358/PERS.76.5.557

entries.name: DPDD
entries.notes: Dual-Pol Diagonal Distance. Formula: (VV+VH)/2.0**0.5. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2018.09.003

entries.name: DpRVIHH
entries.notes: Dual-Polarized Radar Vegetation Index HH. Formula: (4.0*HV)/(HH+HV). Reference: https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.5589/m12-043

entries.name: DpRVIVV
entries.notes: Dual-Polarized Radar Vegetation Index VV. Formula: (4.0*VH)/(VV+VH). Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/app9040655

entries.name: NDPolI
entries.notes: Normalized Difference Polarization Index. Formula: (VV-VH)/(VV+VH). Reference: https://www.isprs.org/proceedings/XXXVII/congress/4_pdf/267.pdf

entries.name: RFDI
entries.notes: Radar Forest Degradation Index. Formula: (HH-HV)/(HH+HV). Reference: https://doi.org/10.5194/bg-9-179-2012

entries.name: VDDPI
entries.notes: Vertical Dual De-Polarization Index. Formula: (VV+VH)/VV. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2018.09.003

entries.name: VHVVD
entries.notes: VH-VV Difference. Formula: VH-VV. Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/app9040655

entries.name: VHVVP
entries.notes: VH-VV Product. Formula: VH*VV. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS47720.2021.9554099

entries.name: VHVVR
entries.notes: VH-VV Ratio. Formula: VH/VV. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS47720.2021.9554099

entries.name: VVVHD
entries.notes: VV-VH Difference. Formula: VV-VH. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS47720.2021.9554099

entries.name: VVVHR
entries.notes: VV-VH Ratio. Formula: VV/VH. Reference: https://doi.org/10.3390/app9040655

entries.name: VVVHS
entries.notes: VV-VH Sum. Formula: VV+VH. Reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IGARSS47720.2021.9554099
